title: A multi-target directed ligands strategy for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease: Dimethyl fumarate plus Tranilast modified Dithiocarbate as AChE inhibitor and Nrf2 activator.
authors: Guo, Jie; Cheng, Maojun; Liu, Peng; Cao, Duanyuan; Luo, Jinchong; Wan, Yang; Fang, Yuanying; Jin, Yi; Xie, Sai-Sai; Liu, Jing
one_liner_zh: 该文研究阿尔茨海默病多靶点小分子药物设计，涉及AChE抑制与Nrf2激活，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，亦无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) possessed intricate pathogenesis. Currently, multi-targeted drugs were considered to have the potential to against AD by simultaneously triggering molecules in functionally complementary pathways. Hence, a series of molecules based on the pharmacophoric features of Dimethyl fumarate, Tranilast, and Dithiocarbate were designed and synthesized. These compounds showed significant AChE inhibitory activity in vitro. Among them, compound 4c(2) displayed the mighty inhibitory activity to hAChE (IC(50) = 0.053 muM) and held the ability to cross the BBB. Kinetic study and molecular docking pointed out that 4c(2) bound well into the active sites of hAChE, forming steady and sturdy interactions with key residues in hAChE. Additionally, 4c(2) as an Nrf2 activator could promote the nuclear translocation of Nrf2 protein and induce the expressions of Nrf2-dependent enzymes HO-1, NQO1, and GPX4. Moreover, 4c(2) rescued BV-2 cells from H(2)O(2)-induced injury and inhibited ROS accumulation. For the anti-neuroinflammatory potential of 4c(2), we observed that 4c(2) could lower the levels of pro-inflammatory cytokines (NO, IL-6 and TNF-alpha) and suppressed the expressions of iNOS and COX-2. In particular, 4c(2) was well tolerated in mice (2500 mg/kg, p.o.) and efficaciously recovered the memory impairment in a Scopolamine-induced mouse model. Overall, these results highlighted that 4c(2) was a promising multi-targeted agent for treating AD.
abstract_zh: 阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer's disease, AD）具有复杂的发病机制。目前，多靶点药物被认为通过同时触发功能互补通路中的分子，具有对抗AD的潜力。因此，基于富马酸二甲酯（Dimethyl fumarate）、曲尼司特（Tranilast）和二硫代氨基甲酸酯（Dithiocarbate）的药效团特征，设计并合成了一系列分子。这些化合物在体外显示出显著的乙酰胆碱酯酶（AChE）抑制活性。其中，化合物4c(2)对人乙酰胆碱酯酶（hAChE）表现出强大的抑制活性（IC(50) = 0.053 μM），并具备穿越血脑屏障（BBB）的能力。动力学研究和分子对接表明，4c(2)能良好地结合到hAChE的活性位点，与hAChE中的关键残基形成稳定而牢固的相互作用。此外，4c(2)作为Nrf2激活剂，能促进Nrf2蛋白的核转位，并诱导Nrf2依赖性酶HO-1、NQO1和GPX4的表达。而且，4c(2)能保护BV-2细胞免受H(2)O(2)诱导的损伤，并抑制活性氧（ROS）积累。针对4c(2)的抗神经炎症潜力，我们观察到4c(2)能降低促炎细胞因子（NO、IL-6和TNF-α）的水平，并抑制iNOS和COX-2的表达。特别地，4c(2)在小鼠中耐受性良好（2500 mg/kg，口服），并在东莨菪碱诱导的小鼠模型中有效恢复记忆损伤。总体而言，这些结果突显了4c(2)作为治疗AD的有前景的多靶点药物。
